title: Coast Guard Responds to Boat Collision off Block Island, Rhode Island
description: Aerial footage of the yacht, Lucia, sinking from a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter Tuesday, Nov. 8, 2016. The air crew launched from Air Station Cape Cod after watchstanders at Coast Guard Sector Southeastern New England received a radio transmission from the captain of the Squeeze Play reporting the collision. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
pass_reason: Daylight yacht sinking on FLIR color cam, but no federal release states the people's outcome; 640x480 HUD
